summary: The previously blocked author supplement was retrieved via Europe PMC. Table S1 gives 431 CS-vs-HFS DESeq2 DEGs. 406 pair by exact Ensembl ID (coverage 0.942): direction 402/406, Pearson 0.898, Spearman 0.903. Library-identity check: 4 of 6 registered libraries are exact author libraries; GSM7349355 and GSM7349358 match no author column. Cohort compatibility therefore fails, and the result is proposed as a scoped, limited method_differences comparison, not concordance. Inference differs: 405 vs 0 FDR<0.1.

manualReview.summary: Author Table S1 retrieved; selected CS/HFS DEGs agree in direction, cohort only partly shared
manualReview.note: The paper (Methods/Figure 2) reports 3 chow-sedentary, 3 chow-running, 4 HFD-sedentary and 4 HFD-running RNA libraries; official GEO SOFT/RAW.tar contain 3 CS, 3 HFS and 4 HFR (no CR) plus 8 miRNA-manipulation samples, and the registered 3-versus-3 cohort uses GSM7349354-GSM7349359. The 3.1 MB author supplement ZIP blocked on PMC in 2026-09 was retrieved on 2026-11-16 through Europe PMC (ijms-25-07188-s001.zip SHA-256 5c63f7e868043522a755ba284debaa4d697b7dc32ccb55ae350de8aef93d197a). Its Supplementary Table S1 (SHA-256 9f4a36246bd83ee1db8eef7e99b0f9c822b2d1b05dabccb5da3f08f67b9d4ffc) lists 431 DESeq2 CS-vs-HFS rows (430 with padj<0.1) with per-library values for all 14 author libraries. Author log2FoldChange equals log2(mean CS/mean HFS) of those values (Pearson 1.0000), so it is negated to HFS minus CS; this matches the paper's 265 down/165 up in CS vs. HFS. Library identity against the deposited HTSeq counts: GSM7349354=CS1, GSM7349356=CS12, GSM7349357=HFS2, GSM7349359=HFS9 and all four HFR libraries match exactly, but GSM7349355 (CS_Rep4) and GSM7349358 (HFS_Rep2) match none of the 14 author columns, and author CS16, HFS and HFS17 are not deposited. On the author-selected genes GSM7349355 resembles the author HFS libraries more than any CS library; this is an observation, not a label correction. 2026-11-16 scoped comparison against the unchanged registered edgeR-QL output (HFS minus CS): 406/431 author rows pair by exact Ensembl feature through the registered feature map (coverage 0.9420; 21 features without a registered symbol, the summed symbol Tmt1a and absent Ptbp2, Prkcb and Atf3 stay unpaired; none resolved by name); nonzero direction agreement 402/406 (0.9901; Vsnl1, Ndufs1, Clasp2 and Myl9 reversed, all local |logFC|<0.1); Pearson 0.8976, Spearman 0.9026, OLS slope 0.446 (local on author); median absolute LFC 0.806 author versus 0.408 local. An author-symbol join gives 391 pairs, Pearson 0.8952, Spearman 0.8996, 387/391 directions. Registered FDR<0.1 calls: 0 (minimum 0.288) versus 405 of 406 paired author genes. Selected-gene evidence only; the author nonsignificant tail is not available. Evidence is in continued-sources/GSE232510/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.
reviewFlags: Two registered libraries (GSM7349355 CS_Rep4, GSM7349358 HFS_Rep2) match no author Table S1 library, and three author libraries (CS16, HFS, HFS17) are not deposited; the author and registered CS/HFS cohorts share 4 of the 6 registered libraries.
Author DESeq2 fit over 14 libraries (CS, CR, HFR, HFS) versus registered edgeR-QL 3 versus 3; 405 versus 0 FDR<0.1 calls among paired genes.
Selected 431-gene FDR<0.1 reference only; the author tested universe and nonsignificant tail are not available.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered edgeR-QL HFD-sedentary minus chow-sedentary female ARC, 3 versus 3 deposited libraries GSM7349354-GSM7349359.
comparabilityReview.reference: Author Supplementary Table S1 (ijms-25-07188-s001.zip via Europe PMC): 431 DESeq2 CS-vs-HFS rows at FDR<0.1 (one at 0.1001), log2FoldChange CS over HFS, negated.

cohort.note: Deposited HTSeq counts match author columns exactly for GSM7349354 (CS1), GSM7349356 (CS12), GSM7349357 (HFS2) and GSM7349359 (HFS9); GSM7349355 and GSM7349358 match none of the 14 author libraries, and author CS16, HFS and HFS17 are not deposited. Author fit: 3 CS + 4 HFS within 14 libraries.

contrast.note: Both HFD-sedentary versus chow-sedentary female ARC. Author orientation CS over HFS is established from the table's own per-library values (Pearson 1.0000 with log2 mean CS/HFS) and negated to HFS minus CS.

features.note: 406/431 author Ensembl IDs join registered rows through the registered feature map; 21 features without a registered symbol, one summed symbol and three absent rows stay unpaired, none resolved by name.

effects.note: Author unshrunk DESeq2 Wald LFC from a 14-library fit versus registered edgeR-QL logFC from 3 versus 3; both log2 ratios. 402/406 nonzero directions agree, Pearson 0.8976, Spearman 0.9026, OLS slope 0.446 (registered effects about half the author magnitude).

inference.note: Author 405 of 406 paired genes at FDR<0.1; registered output has 0 genes at FDR<0.1 (minimum 0.288). Cohorts and models differ.

coverage.note: Selected FDR<0.1 DEG list only (0.9420 of it paired); the author tested universe and nonsignificant tail are not available.

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2 direction route evaluated on 406 nonzero pairs covering 0.9420 of the selected reference (402/406 agree); Pearson and Spearman reported at the 0.90 line. Cohort compatibility is not supported (2 of 6 registered libraries are not author libraries), so no concordance acceptance is established; a significant-only list cannot establish full-universe agreement.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Selected author CS/HFS effects agree in direction (402/406) with correlation near 0.90, but cohort, inference and coverage remain qualified.

additionalComparisonSpec.authorMethod: DESeq2 Wald (unshrunk LFC) fitted across 14 CS/CR/HFR/HFS libraries; CS versus HFS; FDR<0.1
additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: Author log2FoldChange (CS over HFS, established from the table's per-library values) is negated in the extraction to HFS minus CS; the logFC column is already oriented.
additionalComparisonSpec.note: Selected author reference: Supplementary Table S1, 431 CS-vs-HFS DESeq2 rows (430 with padj<0.1). Author Ensembl IDs join through the registered feature map; unpaired rows keep their Ensembl ID as key and stay unpaired. Only 4 of 6 registered libraries are author libraries (GSM7349355 and GSM7349358 match no author column), so cohort compatibility is not established; selected author effects agree in direction (402/406) but cohort, inference and coverage remain qualified.
